# opnsense_routing_gateway_group (Resource)

Configures an OPNsense gateway group for failover or load balancing.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique gateway-group name.
- `tier1` (Set of String) Gateway names in tier 1. At least one gateway is required.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `pool_options` (String) Pool behaviour: empty for default, `round-robin`, or `round-robin sticky-address`.
- `tier2` (Set of String) Gateway names in tier 2.
- `tier3` (Set of String) Gateway names in tier 3.
- `tier4` (Set of String) Gateway names in tier 4.
- `tier5` (Set of String) Gateway names in tier 5.
- `trigger` (String) Failure trigger: `down`, `downloss`, `downlatency`, or `downlosslatency`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the gateway group.
